_README: Copy this file to gate_check.config.json (repo root, NOT inside scripts/).
gate_check.config.json is .gitignored — never commit it; it may hold sensitive tokens.
All sections are optional. Missing sections are silently skipped by gate_check.
Use _doc strings inside each section to understand each field.
Sections: deploy (SHA verification), sentry (post-deploy error scan).

_doc: Verifies the running deploy's commit SHA matches local git HEAD.
Set 'provider' to any label (Railway, Vercel, Render, Fly, etc.).
Set 'query' to any shell command that prints the deployed SHA to stdout.
If the query fails or returns empty, gate_check reports a failure.
See _alternative_deploys below for copy-paste provider templates.
deploy.query: curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RAILWAY_TOKEN" https://backboard.railway.app/graphql/v2 -d '{"query":"query{ project(id:\"<PROJECT_ID>\"){ deployments(first:1){ edges{ node{ meta } } } } }"}' | jq -r '.data.project.deployments.edges[0].node.meta.commitHash'

_alternative_deploys._doc: Copy one of these 'query' values into the deploy section above.

vercel._doc: Requires VERCEL_TOKEN env var and your team/project slugs.

render._doc: Requires RENDER_API_KEY env var and your service ID.

fly._doc: Requires flyctl installed and authenticated. Replace <APP_NAME>.

_doc: Fails gate_check if any new Sentry issues fired on the current release
Requires SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN env var (an internal integration token from
Sentry Settings > Developer Settings > Internal Integrations).
org: your Sentry organization slug (from sentry.io/settings/<org>/).
release_query: shell command that prints the release identifier.
Defaults to 'git rev-parse HEAD' if omitted.
since_minutes: how far back to look for issues. Defaults to 60.
